prompt: Audit the existing site, fix what is broken, then roll seed 77 for the open dimensions. Show resolved findings separately from rolled choices. Let me lock the accent direction and re-roll.
assertions: Separates resolved findings (deterministic) from rolled choices (seed-dependent).
Audit findings are resolved before the roll — they do not vary by seed.
Candidates are generated from context, not from a static option file.
Lock persists across re-rolls; only unlocked dimensions change.
Relaxed gate is applied (not the full tastecheck-pass strict gate).

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Each seed must produce materially different rolled choices while keeping the same resolved findings.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (design-system-interview) must be available as the manual alternative when the user rejects the rolled direction.
